name: lspf-analysis
description: Tells you, while you type, which functions are getting hard to work with.

lspfAnalysis.health.complexityThreshold.markdownDescription: Cognitive complexity scoring 50%. Scores the control-flow pillar alongside cyclomatic complexity; the pillar takes whichever of the two scores worse.

lspfAnalysis.health.cyclomaticThreshold.markdownDescription: Cyclomatic complexity scoring 50%. Scores the control-flow pillar alongside cognitive complexity; the pillar takes whichever of the two scores worse. McCabe's recommended upper bound is 10.

lspfAnalysis.health.lengthThreshold.markdownDescription: Statements (logical lines) scoring 50%. The only measure of the size pillar.

lspfAnalysis.health.workingMemoryThresho.markdownDescription: Names held at once scoring 50%. Scores the vocabulary-load pillar alongside Halstead difficulty; the pillar takes whichever of the two scores worse.

lspfAnalysis.health.halsteadDifficultyTh.markdownDescription: Halstead difficulty scoring 50%. Scores the vocabulary-load pillar alongside working memory; the pillar takes whichever of the two scores worse.

lspfAnalysis.health.weights.complexity.markdownDescription: Weight of the control-flow pillar in the quality blend. Weights are normalized by their sum, so only their ratio matters.

lspfAnalysis.health.weights.length.markdownDescription: Weight of the size pillar in the quality blend.

lspfAnalysis.health.weights.workingMemor.markdownDescription: Weight of the vocabulary-load pillar in the quality blend.

lspfAnalysis.health.weights.interface.markdownDescription: Weight of the interface pillar in the quality blend. Half the others by default: a wide signature is a real signal, but a narrower one than the three pillars describing what a function does.

lspfAnalysis.health.parametersThreshold.markdownDescription: Parameter count scoring 50%. The only measure of the interface pillar.

lspfAnalysis.health.qualityWarn.markdownDescription: Quality below this is reported as a warning.

lspfAnalysis.health.qualityError.markdownDescription: Quality below this is reported as an error rather than a warning.

lspfAnalysis.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Publish diagnostics at all. Turning this off clears what is displayed.

lspfAnalysis.diagnostics.perMetric.markdownDescription: Also report a function whose quality passes but which has one badly scoring pillar, as a hint.

lspfAnalysis.diagnostics.file.markdownDescription: Also report the file as a whole when its quality is bad enough to be an error.

lspfAnalysis.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the active file's overall quality in the status bar.

lspfAnalysis.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to an `lspf-analysis` binary to use instead of the one packaged with this extension. A leading `~` is expanded.

lspfAnalysis.trace.server.description: Trace the messages exchanged with the language server.
